title: Budget and expenses
audience: For anyone who wants to know where the money went without a budgeting app.
description: A budget app: what's left this month, spending by category, quick add. Edit it yourself, or tell your AI what you spent and it logs it.
tagline: What you spend, against a monthly budget.
seoTitle: Budget and expense log template for ChatGPT and Claude
note:
Budget and expenses

What you spend, one row each, and a monthly budget to measure it against. Amounts are in your own currency.

## Month summaries

prompt.default: Use my Pinto Notes note "Budget and expenses". It is an app; its data is "Home/Budget and expenses.app/data.json". Read it with fetch before each change. When I tell you what I spent, add one item to values.expenses with edit: a new id, date as yyyy-mm-dd, what, a category that is a name in values.categories, and amount as a number. I can add, edit and delete expenses and change the budget in the app myself. At the end of the month, when I ask, compare each category with its budget and tell me what was over, what was under, and one suggestion. Don't give financial advice beyond that.

asks: Spent 412 on groceries and 85 on the bus card today.
How am I doing against the budget this month?
What did we spend on eating out in September?

args.new_string:
| 2026-09-28 | Weekly shop | Groceries | 412 |
| 2026-09-28 | Bus card | Transport | 85 |

| 2026-09-28 | Bus card | Transport | 85 |
| 2026-09-29 | Pizza with friends | Eating out | 260 |

## Month summaries
**September:** eating out was 1,840 against 1,500, mostly two dinners in the last week. Groceries came in 300 under. Suggestion: plan two more dinners at home next month.
